notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin needs the object pronoun for 'to kill him/them'; Hebrew leaves למותת bare.

notes.subject: bel
notes.gloss-note: לבב rendered 'bel' per D4 — heart as seat of feeling in Hebrew, belly/insides in Tok Pisin idiom.

notes.subject: khesed
notes.gloss-note: חסד kept as 'khesed' per D2 — kindness/loyalty; 'marimari' alone would mislead.

notes.subject: ונכאה לבב
notes.rationale: 'smitten of heart' — a beaten-down heart rather than 'brokenhearted' (grief); renderings split between 'broken in heart' (KJV) and 'crushed in spirit' sense.

translation: Long wanem em i no tingim long wokim khesed, tasol em i bihainim ⟨את⟩ man poro na ⟨את⟩ man i no gat samting, na ⟨את⟩ man bel i bruk, bilong kilim ⟨em⟩.

tokens.gloss: na man i no gat samting
